dataset: Authorized isolated local API with synthetic fixtures

definitions.cold: Real login to prepare the role, then HTTP cache cleared; navigation from the address bar into the requested route.
definitions.reload: Browser reload of the same route with HTTP cache intact.
definitions.warm: First usable navigation by app link from a neighbouring route after login.
definitions.cached: Second navigation by the same link after visiting the previous route again.
definitions.ready: Visible heading, dashboard chart or detail dialog as appropriate, then two animation frames. Empty states are allowed; errors are recorded. For authentication pages, LCP collection continues until the hero decode settles without changing the ready timestamp.
definitions.inpLab: Maximum observed Event Timing interaction duration in the measured lab actions. Null when no qualifying interaction; not field INP.
definitions.lcp: Largest-paint entry from initial document navigation only, without field aggregation.
definitions.cls: Max layout shift session window without recent input. Warm SPA phases report only their local shifts.
definitions.requests: Document and completed resources visible to Resource Timing around the measured phase.
definitions.bytes: Browser Resource Timing transfer/encoded/decoded sums. Cross-origin API sizes may be redacted without Timing-Allow-Origin; CDP apiWireBytes is separate.
definitions.cpu: Chromium Performance scripting/layout cumulative duration deltas and end-of-phase JS heap.
